description.value: Ramie's Greek Restaurant is a family-owned Greek restaurant on Burnaby's Kingsway corridor, celebrating 25 years in business. It has been voted Best Greek Restaurant in Burnaby, winning the Quality Business Award for both 2023 and 2024 based on satisfaction, quality, service, and reputation. The restaurant is operated by owner Ramie and his two sons, with a stated commitment to authenticity and quality in their cooking.
